assumptions: DCAS profiles, evidence bundles, and assessments can be modeled as TSMM assurance objects.
Control objectives can be compared through TSMM policy abstractions without claiming identical wording.
prohibitedInferences: Do not infer DCAS assessor accreditation from a TSMM mapping.
Do not treat a mapped policy object as proof that DCAS control procedures were executed.
comparisonNotes: DCAS is the strongest fit for TSMM assurance, evidence, and assessment structures.
validationHints: Verify that each assessment output references evidence and an assurance profile when expressed in TSMM form.
